reviews.title: Great case, a bit pricy, but the RGB ambience is amazing.
reviews.comment: Very nice case. A tad pricey, but the quality is excellent. Installing my board and peripherals were a breeze, and I really enjoy the shroud for the 24 pin cable etc and the ambience of the RGB. Cable management was easy as well, the included ties that you click in are great. Don't think I have made my cabling this nice ever. Stays whisper quiet and cool.
reviews.author: Gordon Freeman

reviews.title: Looks amazing, has fantastic cooling. No worries!
reviews.comment: This case is incredible and looks awesomeness ! It comes with three large cooling fans in the front, tons of cable management and mounting features, tons of space, and should fit most situations. I had to remove the extra cooling duct, which directs airflow to the graphics card because my power supply was too large, but it is easy to remove and the case is very modular. It looks so cool and is easy to control using a web interface. I would definitely buy definitely buy it again for my next build. If you want to save money, then you can get the non-RGB version but I think the value is great, considering what you get in this package.
reviews.author: I. Harker

reviews.title: Fractal Design Meshify 3 Ambience Pro Review
reviews.comment: Needed a new case for my all white build. Purchased a used one and it arrived pretty quickly. Had no issues installing components. No issues with thermals either. Did wish it came with a dust filter. My only issues was that the case did arrive missing a connector for the front panels LED's. Amazon support gave me a slight refund because of this. Also reached out to Fractal an about this and have yet to hear back. Otherwise been a pretty good case.
reviews.author: Bobbert Bobbington

reviews.title: A near perfect case.
reviews.comment:
Rarely write Amazon reviews, but I love this case. The lighting is GORGEOUS (not unicorn vomit, adds ambiance to a stealth build).
The XL version provides tons of space for sure, but I still felt a little cramped in some parts of the build. For one - the cable cover is a bit derpy with an EATX motherboard - and I guarantee you WILL scrape the finish of it against your GPU backplate. It’s a bit questionable that they didn’t make the flaps a little more flexible.
If you’re adding more momentum fans, BE PREPARED FOR A BIT OF HEADACHE. You NEED to buy a 3 pack in order to get the extensions - this means if you get a single one for the back, you will be forced to use a jank combination of the legacy splitter back to the USBC converter. The momentums are a great fan, but I’m not entirely convinced that USBC is the move, it actually led to a bit of headache getting those cable ends to fit in some crevices and I just had to settle for it not being the prettiest in some spots.
Aside from that, I love this case. I say this every time I do a new build, but this is a new favorite (and maybe it’s because they keep getting better!)
Airflow is phenomenal, I’ve never had a PC this quiet.
reviews.author: Brandon Clark
